summary: ASUR (Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste, NYSE: ASR; BMV: ASUR) furnished a Form 6-K carrying its October 2026 monthly passenger traffic release, the routine operating disclosure of a foreign private issuer rather than a transactional event. Total traffic reached 9.3 million passengers, down 0.9% year on year, with declines of 5.4% in Mexico, 6.6% in Costa Rica and 3.5% in Curacao offset by gains of 4.8% in Puerto Rico, 2.8% in Colombia, 0.9% in Brazil and 0.2% in Ecuador. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake or structural mechanics are stated; watch continued Mexican traffic erosion.
